description: Phase 6 — Documentation sync in the SAME milestone. Update the grammar, agent reference, human guide, architecture, comparison/token-efficiency, roadmap, and README to describe the shipped M2 behavior, marking ONLY what actually works as shipped. Must run last so it documents the real final behavior and the measured benchmark numbers. Independent of the other features' code but depends on all of them being complete.
steps: docs/adx-grammar.md: move component resolution + slot projection from 'later milestone' to specified — add a section defining custom-tag resolution against manifest.deps; the two slot sides (child declares `<slot actions />`, parent projects `<template slot="name">`), stating `<slot name="actions"/>` is NOT valid; note `#name` as planned sugar that is ALREADY parseable today (do NOT claim a parser change is needed — HIGH-3); the build-time nature of slots; that data-adx-slot placeholders appear only in standalone compilation; the per-instance hydration attribute data-adx-i="i<ordinal>" and the three-part hook id ${scope}-i${ordinal}-${n}. Pin section 4.3's get*->bare-key lowering to the exact rule (strip 'get', lowercase only the first remaining char; include the getURL->uRL example).

docs/agent-reference.md (keep compact/scannable, reference tables): add --data <file.json>, the page-manifest shape + `adx build <page.json>`, composition syntax, the reactivity contract + its limits (no structural reactivity; computed-backed interpolations not live-patched; non-deterministic setup caveat), and the `npm run benchmark` command. Update the CLI IMPLEMENTED vs PLANNED lists.

docs/human-guide.md (warm tone): add a worked example building a small 2-page site from 2 composed components with real data (index + about, a shared site-header, a user-card with --data / page data). Replace the current #actions slot examples with slot="actions" plus a note that #name is planned sugar parseable now. Fix the stale 'scanned, never executed' phrasing about behavior.adx.js to describe sandboxed setup() execution and its security posture.

docs/architecture.md: update the Runtime section (build-time setup() sandbox; the reactivity patch model) and the 'Compiling runs user code' security note (node:vm narrows but does not eliminate trust; same caution as any untrusted build tool).

docs/comparison.md + docs/token-efficiency.md: add a 'Measured (M2)' section with the real table from benchmark/results.json; keep the prior numbers but label them 'estimated, pre-measurement'; name the verbatim current headline 'Token Efficiency: 65-85% reduction vs. traditional frameworks' as the figure being superseded; if measured savings fall below the advertised 60-80%/65-85% range, adjust the CLAIM to the measured range (not the measurement), with a pointer to `npm run benchmark`.

docs/roadmap.md: flip ONLY the actually-shipped M2 items (data binding, pages, composition, reactivity, benchmark, doc sync) from the ❌/🚧 markers to ✅, and update the 'Next up' framing. README.md: update the roadmap rows + 'Next up' line and keep the version/status accurate. Do not mark sitemap/robots or any out-of-scope item as shipped.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` and `npm test` remain green (docs-only changes do not break the build).
The 'Measured (M2)' table numbers in docs/comparison.md and docs/token-efficiency.md match benchmark/results.json, and the prior figures are clearly labeled estimated.

docs/adx-grammar.md documents composition + both slot sides correctly, states `<slot name="actions"/>` is invalid, notes #name is parseable-now planned sugar (no false parser-change claim), and pins the get*->bare-key rule incl. getURL->uRL.
docs/roadmap.md and README.md mark exactly the shipped M2 items as done and nothing out-of-scope; version/status stay accurate.
docs/human-guide.md contains a working 2-page composed-site example and no longer says setup() is 'scanned, never executed'.
findings:
SHIPPED (docs-only). `npm run build` tsc-clean; `npm test` green at 170 tests (unchanged — docs edits touch no code). All eight target docs updated to the real shipped M2 behavior; only what works is marked done.

docs/adx-grammar.md: status note flipped to 'through M2' (parser unchanged; composition/projection live in the emitter). §1 tag-resolution note points at the new §11. §4.3 pins the get*->bare-key lowering byte-for-byte (strip leading 3-char 'get', lowercase ONLY the first remaining char; incl. getDisplayName->displayName, getURL->uRL, getX->x) and adds computed to the scope walk; §5 references it. §6 rewritten as the slot DECLARATION side: `<slot actions />` valid, `<slot name="actions"/>` INVALID (exact error `Slot may only carry a name and class shorthands`), build-time placeholder only in standalone compilation. New §8a documents the emitter-stamped hydration attrs data-adx-c (shared), data-adx-i="i<ordinal>" (per-instance root), and the three-part hook id data-adx-b="<scope>-i<ordinal>-<n>". New §11 Component composition: dep resolution vs manifest.deps (kebab(name)+basename keys; exact Unknown-component / Dependency-not-found / Dependency-cycle errors), prop passing, projection side `<template slot="name">` with default-slot rules + Duplicate-slot-content / no-slot errors, parent-ownership of projected nodes, per-instance identity. #name documented as planned sugar that is ALREADY parseable today (no false parser-change claim — HIGH-3).

docs/agent-reference.md (compact): CLI IMPLEMENTED vs PLANNED updated to component+page build/check, --data, npm run benchmark. Build-output bullets updated for data-adx-i + three-part hook ids + per-instance INSTANCES-loop glue; scopeId location rule (basename vs repo-relative). New sections: Data binding (--data merge + required-prop error + check-fails-without-data), Build-time sandboxed setup() (globals omitted, 1000ms timeout, non-determinism/import caveats, security = untrusted-build-tool), Pages (page-manifest shape + fields + dispatch + JSON-LD), Composition (slot both-sides, parent-owned projection, N-instance), Reactivity contract (no structural reactivity; computed-backed interpolations frozen/never-blanked; :for events-only; first-patch no-op). Removed the stale '~2,400' token-count footer.

docs/human-guide.md (warm): headline '70% more efficient' replaced with the measured ~13-14% + npm run benchmark pointer. #actions slot examples -> slot="actions" with a planned-#-sugar note (both the user-card usage and the generic slot example). behavior.js paragraph now says setup()/get*() are EXECUTED in the sandbox at build time (not 'copied/scanned only'). Added a 'Giving your component real data' subsection (--data + sandbox + required-prop error), fixed the 'Compiling a component today' commands to pass --data (standalone check/build on user-card without data now fails by design) with a callout, and added a worked 'small 2-page site from composed components' section using the real fixtures/site/{index,about}.json (verbatim to the committed fixtures) + build/check commands + clean-URL/SEO/per-instance notes.

docs/architecture.md: Measurement pillar gained a 'Measured (M2)' note (~13-14%, benchmark pointer, why larger gains are expected at scale). Runtime section flipped to 'M1 + M2': per-instance glue, data-adx-i, three-part hooks, slot projection, scopeId location rule; added 'Build-time execution of setup() (sandboxed)' with the omitted-globals/timeout model and the 'Compiling runs user code' security note (vm narrows but does not eliminate trust; child-process/worker is the later upgrade); added a 'Reactivity (patch model, no vDOM)' subsection with the documented limits.

docs/comparison.md + docs/token-efficiency.md: added a 'Measured (M2)' table at the top of each matching benchmark/results.json EXACTLY — understand ADX 542/React 627 = 13.6%, modify-style 254/293 = 13.3%, add-prop 288/334 = 13.8% (per-file: manifest 115, structure 83, behavior 90, style 254; React tsx 334, css 293). Prior sections relabeled 'estimated, pre-measurement' with the 73/81/86/95% per-task estimates called out as estimates. comparison.md Summary headline 'Token Efficiency: 65-85% reduction' explicitly named as superseded by the measured ~13-14%; token-efficiency.md 'Token Savings: 70%' annotated likewise and the Measurement Methodology rewritten (gpt-tokenizer o200k_base via npm run benchmark; estimates labelled).

docs/roadmap.md: the M2 section heading flipped from 'Next — Milestone 2' to 'Shipped — Milestone 2'; items 1-6 flipped ❌/🚧 -> ✅ with one-line shipped summaries (data binding, pages, composition, reactivity, benchmark, doc sync). sitemap/robots + patterns + dev server stay under 'Later milestones' (NOT marked shipped). README.md: intro reworded to the measured figure + 60-80% target framing; Build & Compile section updated (component+page build/check with --data, two-page site example, benchmark script, sandbox note, dispatch rule, dropped the hard '77 tests' count); Status 'Next up' flipped to 'Shipped — Milestone 2' + a real next-up list; Development Roadmap table flipped the M2 rows to ✅ and ADDED a 'Sitemap / robots.txt — ❌ Not Started' row (kept out-of-scope items unshipped).

VERIFICATION from worktree root: `npm run build` (tsc clean) + `npm test` (21 files, 170 passed) both green after the edits. Committed locally; not pushed.
